{{Quote|Battle Hydras, or something like that, have settled into the ecosystem of Yavin 4. I had to persuade Jacen not to take one as a pet.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] account of the Battle Hydra|<ref name="BOS" />}}
The '''Battle Hydra''' was a type of large reptilian [[dragon]]-like [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] that was created by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="TJAS" />

==Biology and appearance==
Physically, a battle hydra was a sinuous reptile with leathery wings.<ref name="TJAS" /> It should be noted that no two of these animals were identical though all shared the same general description.<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Typically,<ref name="JATM" /> they were known to hold two heads that sat atop long, fluid necks. The heads held a pair of yellow slitted eyes.<ref name="TJAS" /> Whilst this was usually the case, there were some varieties of these beasts that had more than two heads.<ref name="JATM" /> At the back was a long wicked,<ref name="TJAS" /> whip-like tail that held a hooked stinger.<ref name="JATM" /> The stinger glistened with a strong and acidic crystallized poison<ref name="TJAS" /> that dripped from the tail.<ref name="JATM" /> Four powerful legs were tipped with hooked claws<ref name="TDSS" /> that were both tough and sharp<ref name="TJAS" /> as well as easily capable of ripping the flesh from the beasts victims.<ref name="TDSS" /> The body of the beast contained muscular torsos that were sheathed in iridescent scales.<ref name="TJAS" /> This was forever altered at a molecular level by the Sith alchemy that had altered their physiology.<ref name="TDSS" /> The skin was infused with ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alloys that reduced the damage sustained by the beast.<ref name="JATM" /> The armor alloy introduced into their basic physiology even reduced the damage from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attack.<ref name="TDSS" />

[[File:Battle_hydra_JATM.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A battle hydra.]]
When left to their own devices, these beasts were mindless and shy creatures<ref name="TJAS" /> that was a contrast to their fearsome appearance.<ref name="TDSS" /> When searching for food, battle hydras were known to be solitary animals that hunted alone.<ref name="TDSS" /> Much of their existence involved them being aloft where they rode thermal currents in search of prey or threats. When these were spotted, the battle hydra dove through the air where they snapped with multiple jaws<ref name="TDSS" /> as well as attacked with their teeth, claws and poisoned stinger.<ref name="JATM" /> Once prey succumbed to either the attack or poison, the beast took the corpse back to its lair where it was torn apart and devoured.<ref name="JATM" /> They only ever attacked with their claws once they landed and were beginning to feed.<ref name="TDSS" />

These animals were, however, susceptible to influence or commands from [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] users.<ref name="JATM" /> Normally, they did not attack an individual unless cornered or spurned by the will of a Sith Lord.<ref name="TJAS" /> Many of them used their battle hydra as their own personal shocktroopers<ref name="JATM" /> and it was only on such commands did they ever attack in numbers.<ref name="TDSS" /> Battle hydras were known to be particularly attracted to sites that were strong in the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was believed that perhaps these beasts perhaps drew some form of nourishment from these locations.<ref name="JATM" />

==History==
In [[3997 BBY]]-[[3996 BBY]], the Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun studied the dark [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sciences within the depths of the planet Yavin 4.<ref name="TJAS" /> His experimentation in the arts of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] resulted in the creation of the battle hydra.<ref name="JATM" /> This alchemical creation was formed as a fierce guardian creature to test his theories. After Kun's death in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the battle hydras retreated into deep mountain caverns where they dwelt in the shadows. They became a rare sight on Yavin 4.<ref name="TJAS" /> In time, the beasts regressed to typical predator behavior where their small population only emerged from the mountain caves in order to hunt.<ref name="TDSS" /> Normally, they prowled the skies of the steamy jungle moon, though their creator's travels did leave the possibility that some were located on other planets so long as there was an abundant supply of food.<ref name="JATM" />

Battle hydras were forgotten for millennia until the early days of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]]. In this time, the dark shade of Exar Kun's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] summoned the mutated hydras to attack the comatose body of Skywalker. His [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] students had encountered a variant of the creature that had three heads and possessed no forelegs. The beasts would have succeeded in their goal had Master Skywalker not acted through his nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to fight off the animal with a lightsaber. Another swarm of hydras were summoned to complete their master's will but were destroyed when [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] borrowed a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. After this event, the [[New Jedi Order]] only rarely encountered battle hydras. Without Exar Kun's will to control them, the animals avoided all contact with sentient beings, except for rare attacks on those who seemed to threaten them.<ref name="TDSS" />

With Exar Kun destroyed, the creatures were believed to either have reverted to their more natural forms or simply to have died out,<ref name="TDSS" /> although [[Tenel Ka Djo]] encountered a group of them in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref>
